name: Cloudflare Pages
description: Publish artifact versions to Cloudflare Pages with public or email-restricted access, Web Analytics, a dashboard analytics link, address changes, update, restore and remove sites.

settings.label: Cloudflare API token
settings.description: Cloudflare Pages Edit for this account. For Web Analytics it also needs Account Settings Read and Write.

settings.label: Cloudflare Access API token (optional)
settings.description: For Restricted sites: Access Apps and Policies Write, plus Access Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Read, scoped to this account. Set up Zero Trust and One-time PIN first.
